peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 17.8% above its local comparables; 124 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (62.5): 3.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 250 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 6). Context, not scored: resales in 75% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: King Albert Park MRT about 670 m, Sixth Avenue MRT about 830 m; closer than 75 of 551 similar developments (the same as 3). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Methodist Girls' School (Primary) about 650 m; more than 107 of 551 similar developments (the same as 202). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 6 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 500 m), more than 212 of 551 similar developments (the same as 62); nearest hawker centre Bukit Timah Market about 1,630 m; nearest park Maple Lane Park about 440 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Amberwood at Holland, 24 new sales, about 490 m; Dunearn House, 237 new sales, about 500 m; The Reserve Residences, 2 new sales, about 1,570 m; 8@BT, 34 new sales, about 1,710 m; Pinetree Hill, 58 new sales, about 1,990 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 59 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 355 new sales and 226 resales (581 purchases); new sales were 61.1% of these purchases. Subsales (8) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Dunearn Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 430 m; Holland Plain GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 570 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 226 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 2 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 226 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 271 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−16.6%). Planning-area private resales −4.6%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
